entities.name: PMID:25092099
observations: In aganglionic rat jejunum, transplanted GFP-labeled skin-derived precursor cells produced GFP-positive structures resembling enteric ganglia between the longitudinal and circular smooth-muscle layers.
The study assessed ganglia using S100 and beta-III tubulin/TUJ1 immunohistochemistry; it concluded that SKPs engrafted, migrated, and differentiated into ganglion-like structures in vivo.

entities.name: PMID:25487489
observations: In aganglionic rat jejunum, SKP-derived GFP-positive clusters appeared in the intermuscular layer by post-transplant days 14–28.
These clusters co-expressed mature neuronal and glial markers and showed markers of neurotransmitter synthesis; the authors concluded that SKPs can generate enteric ganglia in vivo.

entities.name: Skin-derived precursors
observations: Neural-crest-associated precursor cells transplanted into aganglionic rat intestine in the cited studies.

entities.name: Intestinal aganglionosis
observations: Experimental rat jejunal aganglionosis was induced with benzalkonium chloride to model the absence of enteric ganglia.
